objective: Choose one natural, minimal, coherent grounding event for L000 without writing pages, dialogue, comprehension, exercises, or assets.
l000_kernel_rules: Use direct teaching interaction as the setting; do not introduce a village location, board, sorting task, label worksheet, or extra world state.
Use the smallest cast: Ninereeds and Taro only. Bind Taro to canonical-person-taro-nakamura-v1.
The natural event is one greeting interaction in which Taro's initially unknown identity becomes known and the exchange closes.
Do not introduce a distractor merely to include OR. The story need not contain every L000 form.
Score only the stable-name relation grounded for Ninereeds and Taro in this event; the full lesson handles the remaining supplied names.
Keep visual representation constraints as safety metadata, not learner knowledge.
Set chronology.mode to noncanonical_instructional: this policy-added book must not create a canonical first meeting or acquaintance event.
Copy every required_input_binding byte-for-byte, including each SHA-256.
Use no learner-facing text in this stage.
required_output: One closed JSON object following story-kernel.template.json and copying required_input_bindings exactly.
forbidden_work: read failed story or kernel outputs
decision_rule: Pass only if the kernel is one minimal natural event, uses noncanonical instructional chronology, and clearly leaves nonessential forms to practice. Otherwise alarm.
